title: Lord's Supper
definition: The Lord’s Supper is the Christian ordinance in which believers partake of bread and cup in remembrance of Christ’s body and blood, proclaiming His death until He comes.
summary: The Supper is a Gospel sign of remembrance, communion, thanksgiving, examination, and hope. It directs the church back to the cross and forward to Christ’s return.
christFocus: At the Lord’s Table, believers remember Christ crucified, feed by faith on His finished work, and proclaim that salvation is in Him alone.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: It calls believers to self-examination, unity, gratitude, and hope.
